M-TWEEN-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Duration-based interpolation: move a value toward a target over a duration through an easing curve, supporting retargeting and speed calibration.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: TweenBehavior<T>: duration, easing curve, elapsed progress, retargeting.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Easing curve library and the Animate authoring facade. Speed calibration for normalized progress. Physical (non-linear-time) motion — owned by M-SPRING-BEHAVIOR.

Requirements.REQ-001: Retargeting mid-flight interpolates from the current value, preserving elapsed-time semantics per SS-BEHAVIOR-PRIMITIVES.REQ-001.
Requirements.REQ-002: Progress reaches exactly 1.0 (value == target) and reports Finished; no overshoot for finite easing.

Inputs.IN-002: duration: float — seconds; curve: Easing — easing function.

Outputs.OUT-001: value: T — eased interpolated value each Update.
